The add flow now automatically fetches page metadata after you paste a URL:

- Page title
- Description
- Website icon
- Final redirected URL

The form stays editable before saving. I also verified that customized titles save correctly and that the fetched icon appears on the bookmark card.

[See the auto-filled add dialog](/work/prototypes/add-bookmark-autofill.png), or try it live at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).
